text:
deploy-bot: deploy rls-2026-03-15.13 finished to prod-canary - traffic split increased to 40% for model-serving-v2. Observability: 502/504 spike, p95 latency +420ms, error budget burn. paging alexa (oncall).

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED • Sev2 • Pinged oncall (alexa). PagerDuty: acknowledged.

alexa (oncall): i'm on it. grabbing logs and routing table. looks like most 502s from eu-west1 pool, model-serving-v2 pods.

jordan (eng): do we have a quick kill for the split? feature flag traffic_split_v2 controls rollout. can flip to 0 to send everyone to v1.

alexa (oncall): trying toggle now.

alexa (oncall): toggled flag `traffic_split_v2` -> 0 via admin console. command: 
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/redwood/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"flag":"traffic_split_v2","value":0}'
```

deploy-bot: traffic split rollback observed - canary traffic set to 0%. beginning cooldown.

moe (sre): errors dropping in eu-west1 already, 5xx rate down from 2.1% -> 0.3% within 30s. good sign.

emma (platform): I see stacktraces pointing to `kv-cache` patch, introduced in commit `c3f7a8b`. It changes retry timing and may cause upstream connection timeouts under burst.

jordan (eng): yep that commit was in the canary bundle. patch is small but touches network backoff path. options: 1) revert single commit and redeploy, 2) ship hotfix that reverts backoff change. which is faster?

alexa (oncall): given customer impact (small but real), i'd prefer immediate revert of that single commit and redeploy to canary then scale. can we do a single-commit revert and push a hotfix?

jordan (eng): will prepare revert PR. I'll cut and merge the revert and coordinate a canary redeploy to 10% then 50% if clean.

jordan (eng): creating PR now. commands: 
```
git checkout -b revert/kv-backoff-c3f7a8b
git revert c3f7a8b --no-edit
git push origin revert/kv-backoff-c3f7a8b
# open PR and request @emma review
```

emma (platform): reviewing now. will queue the canary pipeline when PR merges. also pin the logs and save traces for postmortem.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: oncall alexa acknowledged. escalation not required.

sanjay (product): quick note on customer impact - a few customers on EU region reported transient failures for ~3m window. engineering, please capture CIDs and request support notify affected customers if we see retries failed.

alexa (oncall): alexa -> moe handoff in 10m for maintenance window. leaving notes here: toggled flag to 0, traced errors to c3f7a8b, PR revert started (https://git.internal/r/redwood/rls/pull/4219).

moe (sre): taking over monitoring. will watch for regression and coordinate rollback if anything flares up during redeploy.

jordan (eng): PR merged, initiating canary redeploy - pipeline id `pipe-8734`.

deploy-bot: pipeline pipe-8734 started. deploying rls-2026-03-15.13-revert to canary (10%).

moe (sre): canary at 10% - baseline metrics look good. holding 5m.

moe (sre): promoting to 50% now. 5xx steady at baseline, p95 latency normalized.

deploy-bot: canary success. traffic split restored to 100% on rls-2026-03-15.13-revert.

alexa (oncall): monitoring post-fix window. current error budget burn back to normal. marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED • Severity reduced to S3 • Recording timeline to incident channel.

sanjay (product): preliminary customer impact: ~1.8% of EU requests affected during 03:12:12 - 03:15:45 UTC, ~27 unique customers saw at least one failed request. Support to coordinate outbound: /cc @support-team.

jordan (eng): created follow-up tasks:
- capture CI artifacts and full trace archive (ticket #INC-5921)
- postmortem draft (assigned to jordan)
- add an automated canary assertion for kv-cache backoff thresholds
- feature flag playbook update for immediate rollback steps

alexa (oncall): handing back to regular oncall rotation. leaving pinned logs and runbook notes in incident ticket.

moe (sre): thanks all. thumbs up to quick detection and single-commit revert flow. please ensure we include the exact metric query used in the postmortem. :thumbsup:

sanjay (product): +1 on customer comms. i'll prepare a short summary for affected customers once we have final numbers.

jordan (eng): closing thread with the revert commit id `d4e9b2c` as the hotfix-build. timeline saved.

deploy-bot: deploy rls-2026-03-15.13-revert completed at 1738642260.

moe (sre): last check 5xx <0.1% for 10m, moving incident to resolved and filing postmortem draft.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • Duration 8m 45s • Postmortem pending.
